text: ATCHIEVEMENT, in heralyly denotes the arms of a person, or family, together with all the exterior ornament of the fluid; as helmes, mantle, credit, fcrolls, and motto, together with fuch quarterings as may have been acquired by aliiances, all marhalled in order.
